notes.title: Different Endings Update released!
notes.notes:
The final two endings are uncovered in the latest update to Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder. 

One new ending finishes the story that the in-game comic started, how Clayton destroyed the civilization of the Elder Lizards and killed their King. Now comes accountability, and maybe even absolution.

The other is a fun one about Chompys, the living chests who for inexplicable reasons have invaded the Cave Digger world. Some creatures are best kept on a tight leash, but now it is too late as you will see!

notes.title: Maids and Nerds: Update v1.1.12.8
notes.notes:
Howdy prospectors! We have a new minor update, Nerds, and Maids! 
Are you a nerd? Do you like maids? Well, now you can be IRL self in VR or be a maid digging for riches! ːsteamhappyː

Now there are two new costumes that you can find and purchase in-game. Be sure to collect them all! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/9f91b9854cec8a33cf76856f375933a70be6eb4e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/98f231fae56f9b86635aa6e59dc74eb50b135466.jpg

We also fixed many bugs. One of them being the sentinel torso being non-damaging after death. You won't get hurt anymore by the guardian's corpse in Eerie ruins anymore, so don't be afraid to jump around them!  
A lot of the bugs we fixed this time were found by the community so thank you so much to the people who reported the bugs and continuously help us to improve the game! 

There are other fun features we added, such as being able to slap another player now. Before, your hands went through, but now you can slap them across the face if they try to dynamite you to death! 

Oh and we've launched Cave Digger 2 in PSVR2 and Pico so you will now be able to play crossplay with all of the players across all the platforms. 
More multiplayer, more mayhem, and more explosion and digging! ːsteamhappyː


You can find all the updates we did in the list below:

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE: The Return of the Chompys!
notes.notes:
Howdy, frontier miners! 

Your CM Jacky🥝 here with a small sneak peak to our next major update, The Return of the Chompys!! 
This major update will have many changes to the game that will affect your runs, along with more enemies, endings, and most of all, more Chompys! 
There is no set date for this update yet, but know that it will be soon! I will post another update with more details when it comes alive. 

We have been posting sneak peaks all the time in our discord, so if you want to see more, be sure to visit us and say hello in the Saloon to the devs! ! 🍻

Chompys, Chompys, and more Chompys! 

As the title suggests, we are adding more Chompys in our next update. Namely the Miner Chompy, punk Chompy, and the Hellraiser Chompy! Please welcome the new addition to the Chompy family. Or they might chase you- literally. Not all of them will be friendly to the miners so you better be fast! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/45b773e57e6d7638e1775ddf3893f572c448d6c8.jpg

Roll the roulette prospector! 

With this new system brought to you by the Merchant Trading Company, you will be able to decide what kind of situation you will face deep in the mines! Will you have more riches? Or will you have more peril and mayhem? Only way to know is to ROLL. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/e33dd9b92a6cbb3c638efb27647bfc53db1b9d84.jpg

New enemy 

Guess who's new in town! That's right, it's The Drone. He will fly, he will zap, and he will shoot the adventurous miners that comes in eerie ruins with weak and feeble minds! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/324f211ff179abc8293c96a93b7867e43eadc7cb.jpg

New costumes 

These are just few examples of costumes that you will be able to obtain in while digging and mining in the Caves! You'll have to unlock it from the menu after finding relics that correspond to the costumes. If you don't know how, just ask us in discord! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/2f29e210b454caa18d843775efe1b3389a0e11a2.jpg

What in the tarnation?

What the..... don't just stand there Clayton! Everyone RUN!!!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/4872abd4b628f3109609e5c0c38d4018633c34ad.jpg


Join our community in discord for monthly community events, bug reports, and to hang out and play the game with the devs!

notes.title: Full release on 8th of September!
notes.notes:
Howdy cave diggers!

On September 14th, 2021, we released Cave Digger 2: Dig Harder on Steam Early Access. We did it to test the game on a bigger audience and receive valuable feedback from our dedicated VR prospectors. Now it's finally time to release the full version of the game!

First things first, the price will go up at the full release so now it's a good time to purchase the game with the early access discount and invite your friends to join in.

And let's talk a bit about the biggest changes coming...

The fourth area, The Eerie Ruins

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/9d0c94a62519a2c081eb469709d1b3e19538b8b8.jpg

A mysterious mountain top featuring strange temples, statues and otherwordly devices. These mines will be more challenging and dangerous than the previous ones. The area will introduce a new enemy type, new puzzles and treasures. Check out this previously released video for more teasing:

[previewyoutube=ZOrviASnC1U;full][/previewyoutube]

Tool upgrades/changes

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/1e943e448740234190e4c9f9ae8f95ea83b886c6.jpg

Shovel

As seen in the video above, the biggest upgrade will be to the shovel. You'll get a grappling hook mechanic to it and oh boy, it's been an instant hit in our internal testing sessions. We hope you will enjoy it as much as we do!

Pan

Slotting the pan in the arm slots will now transform it into a shield! Quite handy against those plasma shrimp projectiles.

Using the gold pan is also now considerably easier and faster.

Endings

Three new completely unique endings will be added. Not spoiling anything about those yet.



The Golem

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/914a2cfa82b079a03ca49a4116d1d23dcbd22a71.jpg

A new enemy type, the golem, is sleeping in the mines. A strong suggestion is to not disturb his sleep, and if you do, trust your fight or flight instinct. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/d3d54bc0827d7d6c1b4f6edab9f62ec5d25f6f7a.jpg


Other changes include things like new cosmetics (now unlockable), achievements, chompy stuff and other small things. Of course a lot of bug fixing and performance work has been going on in the background.

Now fear not, this is not the end of the development. We have a bunch of content still planned and coming, but more about that later.


Join the Cave Digger discord!

notes.title: Major Early Access update 2: Escape from the Valley
notes.notes:
Update 2: Escape from the Valley

[previewyoutube=54dSk4mb7GY;full]
[/previewyoutube]

Escape from the valley is a major content update for Cave Digger 2: Dig harder. The update makes the game bigger, better and more dangerous than it was before. A new biome brings new challenges and the tools get new mechanics! We've listened to the player feedback and made many general improvements and quality of life changes. Watch the video and read below to know more.


The First Ending
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/69be970934b30278bfd0f58a60f116e20dd5cac5.png

CD1 was known by it's multiple endings so of course we're bringin that back in CD2. The first of the endings is now in the game. I'm not gonna spoil you anything, but let's say the update's name is a hint. You'll find more clues around the game!

You'll be able to continue the game normally after the ending credits play. It's not really an ending, more just an ending to a story-line.


Biome 3 - The Nest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/d234ef07c96dbbcc08758d736669d54d7b201d74.png

Following Clayton's footsteps to the dry lake bed, player finds their way to the nest biome underneath. This biome takes a proper use of the climbing mechanics we introduced in the halloween patch as an experimental feature. It's more mysterious, dangerous and rich than the biomes before...


New enemies

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/21fd1443f8983c530dbf6998e0425da223e9f0e7.png

Primal Chameleon
The standard enemy encounter in the Nest. Watch out for it's strong tail, long tongue and surprisingly precise throwing arm.

Thieving Chameleon
The sneaky friend of the Primal Chameleon. The Thieving Chameleon will sneak up on you cloaked, and will try to steal your loot. Watch out!


Tool upgrades

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/a55c4a2090257486904847cd5489825476f049fc.png

Worker's Glove
The glove gets it's first upgrade. Purchasing this upgrade will let you "vacuum" the treasures laying nearby, making it easier to collect big amounts of loot quickly.

Sledgehammer
The sledgehammer rocks the caves now with a rocket upgrade. Small yet powerful thrusters are welded on it, making the hammer more powerful, but also enabling the player to fly short distances. The players can reach treasures up in the ceiling or escape hordes of enemies using this!

Revolver
The revolver upgrade adds exploding bullets. Light it up with your handy finger lighter and shoot! You can use it to mine small holes of course, but it's a very effective weapon in combat.

Dynamite
The dynamite gets sticky with the latest upgrades. Stick it up your digging hole, or any wall, weapon or an enemy for a big and strategic boom.


List of all the improvements

notes.title: Upcoming update: The Escape from the Valley
notes.notes:
Howdy, prospectors! 

Soon it is time for another content update: The Escape from the Valley! The exact date is not yet locked in, but we'll let you know as soon as we know. Here's a brief sneak peek of what is coming. We'll post another article at the release with more details, as well as a developer update video. 

Lately, we have been streaming the content from this patch on our twitch channel, so you might've seen some of this stuff already. Anyways...


The Escape from the Valley ending:

The first ending of many to come. I suppose the name hints something, but that's all the spoilers for now. The player's will find clues in the world to figure out this one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/1d2c048aae5049f081cb35dbd096f29aca1ac7c5.png

New biome:

The player will find their way to the third biome, a dry lake bed on which the player's base camp is located. Underneath lies the nest biome, introducing new game mechanics, dangers and loot. The climbing and jumping will finally come in handy here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/ef493f2c90fb90ba03169aaa8408c288485aad92.png


New enemies:

Two new enemy variants will be added. These baddies are the inhabitants of the nest biome, so beware... They're very protective over their homes and treasures. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/92ec64fefad50ee84d10d20ee342936ab18f88e0.png

Tool upgrades:

All of the tools are getting upgrades, and some of them come with interesting modifications. Let's say things can get quite explosive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/a55c4a2090257486904847cd5489825476f049fc.png

Two new graphic novel issues:


Clayton's story continues in two new thrilling issues, where our in-game narrator/guide/mentor/father figure will face even tougher challenges than before.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/e6ffee13ccb8920be485adc16c9c3a254b60357f.png


We'll also be releasing the game on App Lab and SideQuest at the same time with this update. So prepare for more players!


Join our discord channel for more!

notes.title: Just a little seasonal update
notes.notes:
Ho-ho-howdy, diggers!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/ecd06b10f7717514d6f4b3939c4a07b08ef544d4.jpg

The holiday season arrives to the valley and we have a small gift for you so you can celebrate even in the mines while searching for the glimmering stones. 

You can now dress up as Nuuttipukki, a traditional Finnish character, who is comparable to Santa Claus. A young man might dress up as a goat (pukki) on Saint Knut's day and visit houses, demanding food and especially leftover alcoholic beverages. If he didn't get what he wanted, Nuuttipukki would commit evil deeds.

The costume would usually consist of an inverted jacket, a bark mask, and horns. Nuuttipukki is also similar to Krampus, who is a scary character from central European folklore.


Also, if you haven't read last week's announcement, we're now also working on Quest release on Oculus App Lab and SideQuest alongside the next big content update for Steam and Oculus platforms! With the Oculus App Lab release, crossplay coop is also coming which will be great for both random matchmakers and friend groups teaming up over different platforms.

Also in that announcement, we released the latest Cave Digger 2 OST song "Watch me go" last Saturday on our YouTube channel so recommend checking it out!


And of course, join our discord, if you haven't yet!

Cave Digger 2 team wishes everyone happy holiday season!

Update 1: The Grave Digger

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/6e50ebd6b1396db817911224984762b2348a425d.jpg

New Tools

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/f589ab764e557409ba12a3bfb27dc08887d43f30.jpg

A Shovel
Two-handed tool to dig from the muddy piles (and graves) on the ground.

A Goldpan
Wiggle the gold pan around the spots in the water to spawn some loot! This tool can be repurposed as a defensive item to block some nasty plasma shrimp projectiles. 

Errands

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/beb9865dad3f893a534fd1ec817f32b54ecda6ee.jpg

On the map stand, players can now find changing daily errands to run. You can pick three errands at the same time and by completing them, you'll be rewarded with some extra $$$.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/ccb8791d435d1b07c202f6684fee3fce9ea6922d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/cf42b794d0cda5e86db00a57a8454a114c35dff3.jpg

These two are experimental features. You can set things on fire, and you can jump and hang from the ledges. The next update will include biome 3, in which the climbing and jumping will become important. For now, just have fun with it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/d33688309aaee67726a5f3d03565d8164ca34685.jpg

notes.title: Upcoming update: The Grave Digger
notes.notes:
Grave Digger has been a running joke since the release of Cave Digger. It's a common misspelling of the game's name and it never stopped amusing and frustrating us. This time we'll rightfully use it as a name for the first early access content update, as it will take place around Halloween!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/6f646c451abcdf894c27759ba6f892f8a83d1567.jpg


Update 1: The Grave Digger
Estimated time of release: Near the hallow's eve!

New Tools

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/574817ba03149bfc46f136be910a9214cb4ab694.png

A shovel and a gold pan will be added. As to how these work and where to use them, you'll have to wait for it... You might find spots related to them in the game already. 


Errands

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/803b3542d34e32aeba5106acd703f542786018ef.jpg

Around the top world base, players will find changing errands to run. These will be small quests or tasks that will help the players gain money more quickly and have some extra stuff to look out for in the mines.


First issue of the graphic novel

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080980/5ca686b438f21abe3efcb3d4fd87fa836eb54021.jpg

I'm sure you've heard about Clayton by now. You'll find collectible pieces of graphic novel laying around, which will reveal you something about the world you're digging in.


Public matchmaking

Yea, no need to force your friends to buy VR sets anymore.


New loots and wearables

More to mine, more to wear. What more do I need to tell you?

notes.title: Early Access release date moved: 14th of September
notes.notes:
New release date - 14th of September

Unfortunately we have to postpone the Early Access release until the 14th of September. 

During the testing period over the past weeks, we've encountered several new critical issues. We want the game to be in a best possible state (even for the early access) before we're comfortable releasing the game. We also don't want to cut out any content that we've already promised.


Steam Playtesting
Steam Playtest build is enabled and you can help us tackle these issues by requesting access on the store page, testing it out and reporting bugs via the in-game reporting form or discord (link below). Huge thanks to all the testers so far!


Join our discord at discord.gg/cavedigger.
